description:
A user at Acme Corp has accidentally deleted the file 'pricing.pdf' from their website's public_html directory. A backup of the virtual server is available at '/home/ga/backups/acmecorp_backup.tar.gz'.

Your task is to restore ONLY the deleted 'pricing.pdf' file from this backup.

CRITICAL WARNING: The 'index.html' file in the same directory has been updated since the backup was taken. You must ensure that the current 'index.html' is NOT overwritten during the restore process. Performing a full restore that overwrites existing files will result in data loss for the client.
